---
title: "Aquaculture Resilience Evidence Engine"
format: html
---

AREE converts public aquaculture omics studies into harmonized, comparable evidence for resilience-associated biomarker discovery.

The current release focuses on *Crassostrea gigas* and includes real public RNA-seq and Tag-seq reanalyses, harmonized molecular findings, and study-specific evidence cards. The [results website](https://sr320.github.io/AREE-co/) leads with real evidence and keeps synthetic scoring and meta-analysis in a separate demonstration section.

Registered contrasts can share a BioProject or control samples. Their counts do not establish independent replication. See [Interpreting Evidence](interpreting-evidence.md) for the distinction between stress responses, resilience-associated findings and validated markers.

## Run the Demo

```bash
aree harmonize-demo
aree meta-analyze --phenotype thermal_tolerance --feature-type gene
aree score-candidates
aree build-evidence-cards
aree build-demo-report
```

## Guardrail

AREE identifies associations and evidence convergence. It does not claim that single-study significant features are validated biomarkers.
